.claude-plugin/plugin.json.why: Two version lines. This repository's marketplace (ADR 0044) versions the plugin it serves, and the incubator assigns its own on promotion. Everything else in the manifest must match.

skills/gate-*/SKILL.md.why: ADR 0062: every gate takes `--plan` and `--answers <path>`, and marks each takeover, removal, choice and platform question as answerable from the adoption plan. Before that, the only difference was the skill-map link, by design (docs/05-promotion.md row 8). Submitted 2026-11-07 in release set adr-0062-answered-once (incubator#1324 to #1331), tracked by #312. Once it ships and is taken back, this returns to by-design with the skill-map `normalise` pattern.

skills/register-[iv]*/SKILL.md.why: Each copy names its own repository's skill map: docs/02-skill-family.md here, docs/skill-relationship-map.md in the incubator, which substitutes it on promotion (docs/05-promotion.md row 8). Nothing else may differ. Widened to the gates and register-install on re-recording at 0.1.21, once ADR 0059 revision 2 shipped (incubator#1247 to #1253) and the incubator's review fixes were taken back. register-adopt and register-variance folded in on re-recording at 0.1.22, once #1258 shipped and the incubator's 'whose rows list the skills' sentence was taken back.

skills/register-adopt/SKILL.md.why: ADR 0062: pre-flight dispatches every gate with `--plan`, Step 2 lists every change in plain English, Step 3 offers Deploy all / Change an answer / Choose gates / Cancel and writes the answers file, and `--yes` does not answer a plan that lists a platform call. Before that, the only difference was the skill-map link, by design. Submitted 2026-11-07 in release set adr-0062-answered-once (incubator#1324 to #1331), tracked by #312. Once it ships and is taken back, this returns to by-design with the skill-map `normalise` pattern.

templates/adopt/guided.sh.why: § C's base-directory prompt defaulted to $HOME/git, a directory most adopters do not keep projects in, while START-HERE.md § C tells them to run from wherever they do. It now defaults to $PWD, the directory adopt.sh was run from, which adopt.sh never changes before handing over. Submitted 2026-11-07 as incubator#1320 (branch amend/register-install--whome192-20261107), tracked by #304. Since then, § E: when 25-credentials.sh reports no GitHub PAT, it prints START-HERE.md § E's fields and permissions from the guide beside it, the command that stores the token under the project-scoped name, and offers to store a pasted one. Submitted 2026-11-07 on incubator#1320, tracked by #304. Since then, ADR 0065: guided.sh asks which container runtime to use and builds with it, and _lib.sh gains RUNTIME_APPLE and RUNTIME_DOCKER and recognises an Apple container. Not yet submitted.

templates/adopt/_lib.sh.why: Gains project_prefix, the project-scoped Keychain name 25-credentials.sh reads and guided.sh writes, and PAT_MISSING, the words guided.sh reads back from 25-credentials.sh's report; ADOPT_COLOUR keeps colours through the tee guided.sh reads it with. Rides with templates/adopt/guided.sh. Submitted 2026-11-07 on incubator#1320, tracked by #304. Since then, ADR 0065: guided.sh asks which container runtime to use and builds with it, and _lib.sh gains RUNTIME_APPLE and RUNTIME_DOCKER and recognises an Apple container. Not yet submitted.

templates/adopt/25-credentials.sh.why: Reads its project prefix and its missing-PAT message from _lib.sh, so guided.sh can recognise the report. Rides with templates/adopt/guided.sh. Submitted 2026-11-07 on incubator#1320, tracked by #304.

skills/register-adopt/README.md.why: ADR 0062: describes the plain-English change list and the one answer, and what `--yes` now answers. Submitted 2026-11-07 in release set adr-0062-answered-once (incubator#1324 to #1331), tracked by #312.

reference/pre-answered.md.why: New with ADR 0062: the one home of the `--plan` / `--answers` rule every gate and register-adopt read. Submitted 2026-11-07 in release set adr-0062-answered-once (incubator#1324 to #1331), tracked by #312.

reference/unattended.md.why: ADR 0062: the three kinds of question `--yes` never answers may be answered by the plan when it lists them, and `--yes` does not answer a plan that lists a platform call. Submitted 2026-11-07 in release set adr-0062-answered-once (incubator#1324 to #1331), tracked by #312.

templates/adopt/00-tools.sh.why: ADR 0065: the adopt route accepts Apple `container` or Docker. Stage 0 fails only when neither answers, stage 3 asks each runtime that answers, and guided.sh asks the person to confirm the runtime. The template ships the Apple `container` launcher, identical to .devcontainer/bin/, and pins the devcontainer CLI it runs in its own package.json and lock file. Not yet submitted: owed in an incubator amendment to control-register.
